item.title: Judge blocks DHS from ending deportation protections for 350,000 Haitians
item.description: A federal judge on Monday blocked the Trump administration from revoking Temporary Protected Status for Haitians, granting a last-minute reprieve to 350,000 immigrants who were set to lose protections on Tuesday.
